question:
What is the value of

\[ \begin{aligned} &(1 + 11 + 21 + 31 + 41) \\ &\quad {}+ (9 + 19 + 29 + 39 + 49)? \end{aligned} \]
solution:
Pair the smallest addend with the largest, then continue inward. This makes five equal sums:
\[
\begin{aligned}
&(1+49)+(11+39)+(21+29)\\
&\quad +(31+19)+(41+9)\\
&=5\cdot50=250.
\end{aligned}
\]
Every original addend appears exactly once, so reordering and grouping preserve the sum. The value is \(250\), choice \(\mathrm{E}\).
